slides.kicker: CONSUMER FINANCE / CONVENIENCE VERSUS CUSTOMER CREDIT
slides.headline: Convenient Gifting. Interest-Free Financing For Starbucks.
slides.subheadline: Your prepayment finances Starbucks before your first sip.

telemetry.label: Interest earned on your card balance

slides.svgBlueprint: Use a 1080×1350 viewBox with 72px safe margins. Fill background #0A0A0C. Set headline in #F5F5F7 at 100px across four lines; emphasize Interest-Free in #FF2A2A. Draw a tilted #141418 gift card whose ribbon becomes a red arrow toward a coffee cup. Place two telemetry badges below. Keep source references in a separate footer rail.

slides.headline: Convenience Makes Prepayment Feel Invisible
slides.subheadline: Easy gifting disguises who receives the money first.
slides.svgBlueprint: Use the shared 1080×1350 canvas and palette. Put THE APPEAL inside an ink-colored upper panel with dark type and a ribbon icon. Place THE TRADEOFF in a dark lower panel with a red cash arrow entering a storefront before a cup exits. Set body copy at 44px. Add THE CATCH as a full-width surface-colored strip, not a third equal card.

slides.headline: Neither Balance Is Gift-Card Cash
slides.subheadline: Both totals mix cards with other obligations.
sourceNotes: The $1,840.6 million balance-sheet category combines stored-value-card liability and current deferred revenue, including $177.0 million of current Nestlé prepaid royalty. The $1,751.7 million disclosure combines stored-value cards and loyalty-program obligations.
slides.svgBlueprint: Draw a 2×2 matrix using thin ink rules, not boxed dashboard widgets. Split each monetary display into a large exact number and smaller million unit without changing precision. Use red brackets around both headline totals. Connect the $177.0 million cell only to the $1,840.6 million cell. Do not subtract the two totals or imply identical coverage. Keep the detailed source note outside the main visual.

slides.headline: Financing Starts Before Revenue Appears
slides.subheadline: Upfront cash and unspent-balance revenue are separate benefits.

items.title: BUY COFFEE
items.body: Redeeming credit turns prepayment into **purchase revenue**.

items.title: ESTIMATE NONUSE
items.body: **Estimated nonuse becomes revenue** proportionately with redemptions.

callout.title: NO CANCELLATION
callout.body: Recording that revenue **doesn't expire your balance**.​

sourceNotes: Nonredemption estimates reflect historical redemption patterns and applicable payments to government agencies under unclaimed-property laws.
slides.svgBlueprint: Place 01 and 02 on a solid red vertical path, representing loading then purchasing. Branch a dotted path from redemption activity toward 03, showing an estimate rather than another customer payment. Use a wallet, cup, and calculation icon. Keep each body on two lines at 42px. Put NO CANCELLATION in an outlined bottom strip; never depict balances being erased.

slides.headline: Your Balance Earns You Nothing
slides.subheadline: No interest, no deposit insurance—but no expiration.

items.title: NO INSURANCE
items.body: Your card value has **no FDIC insurance**.

slides.svgBlueprint: Draw a large #F5F5F7 receipt polygon on #0A0A0C with a serrated lower edge. Use dark receipt text at 44px and red highlight bands behind the three bold anchors. Identify findings as paraphrases, not quotations. Place the contract date near the receipt header. Overlay a red outlined verdict stamp at the lower right without obscuring text.

slides.headline: Starbucks Benefits Before And After
slides.subheadline: Customer financing comes first; estimated nonuse adds revenue.​

items.title: SEPARATE BENEFIT
items.body: **Nonredemption revenue**, not interest or fresh cash.

slides.svgBlueprint: Set $222.4 as a monumental tabular figure with million immediately underneath. Draw an 840px stacked bar with segment widths calculated from 200.4 and 22.0; use ink and red respectively. Put exact segment amounts in external labels with leader lines. Position two brief benefit captions below. Never label the total profit, interest, or newly received cash.

slides.headline: Prepaid Coffee Is Not A Bank
slides.subheadline: Interest-free financing is real. The bank analogy misleads.​

cashOut.title: CALIFORNIA CASH-OUT
cashOut.qualification: Physical and electronic cards; exactly $15 excluded.

slides.svgBlueprint: Use a narrow left column for THE FINANCING and a wider right column for THE PROTECTION, separated by a red rule. Place YOUR MOVE beneath both in large ink type. Add a surface-colored California strip with below $15 highlighted red, the effective date directly beneath, and the exact-threshold exclusion visible. Finish with the verdict stamp and thefineprint.co.
